notes: CDER Office of Compounding Quality and Compliance letter for a 503B outsourcing facility (Exton, PA): failure to meet 503B conditions (compounding with tirzepatide bulk substance not on the 503B bulks list, missing required label statements, inadequate adverse-event-reporting procedures), plus adulteration from insanitary aseptic conditions and CGMP violations, misbranding (502(f)(1), inadequate directions for use), and unapproved-new-drug status once 503B exemptions are lost. Actual microbial/CFU recoveries (including a Trichoderma oriental air-sample recovery) and a voluntary recall of tirzepatide/semaglutide injection lots for lack of sterility assurance are documented. No FEI is stated in the letter (only the WL number).
